# CloudGuard (CloudGuard Vault)

> Zero-trust personal cloud storage vault with real-time pre-commit AI malware inspection — https://cloudguard.site

## Core Value
CloudGuard Vault secures personal and professional files with direct browser-to-object uploads, automated 3-gate pre-commit threat scanning, AES-256 encryption at rest, and zero-egress CDN delivery:
- **Client-Side SHA-256 Hashing:** Files are fingerprinted in the browser before upload finalization.
- **Abuse.ch MalwareBazaar Verification:** Known malware hashes are intercepted and purged automatically.
- **Stream-Safe PE Header Machine Learning:** Portable Executable binaries (<= 512 MB) are analyzed via FastAPI Random Forest models without writing threats to active vault quotas.
- **Zero-Egress Previews & Encrypted Storage:** Instant in-browser streaming video, WASM HEIC/HEIF decoding, client-side PDF page-1 thumbnails, and `.docx` previews served with `$0/GB` egress via Cloudflare Edge (`files.cloudguard.site`) backed by Backblaze B2.
